archetypes.name: evidence-alignment
archetypes.rationale: Verifies the plan's specific numeric claims (directive counts, line numbers) and structural assumptions (existing parser field order) against actual repository file contents before implementation begins.
archetypes.prompt_body: Read the files named in the plan and verify each numeric assertion matches reality: confirm that `skills/design/SKILL.md` contains exactly 4 orchestrator-inline directives at the claimed line numbers (793, 1081, 1129, 1234), and that each of the six other orchestrator files has exactly 1 such directive. Confirm that the existing `lint-readability-preamble.sh` manifest parser already uses the `IFS=':' read -r path variant expected_count prompt_kind` field order the plan assumes, so the third colon-separated field is genuinely available without parser changes. Verify that the `external-prompt` arm in the existing script already uses `grep -Ec` count comparison (not a boolean existence check), so the plan's 'mirror this pattern' claim is accurate and no additional plumbing is needed. If any claimed count is wrong or the parser field order differs, the resulting lint script will silently pass or fail on incorrect thresholds from day one. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
